MATCH (t:Task) WHERE t.status <> 'done' RETURN t.id AS id, t.title AS title, t.status AS status ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
MATCH (m:Milestone) RETURN m.id AS id, m.title AS title, m.status AS status ORDER BY m.order
MATCH (d:Deviation) RETURN d.id AS id, d.title AS title, d.status AS status ORDER BY id
MATCH (m:Milestone)-[r:INCLUDES]->(t:Task) RETURN m, r, t LIMIT 40
MATCH (s:Spec)-[r]->(c:Section) RETURN s, r, c LIMIT 60
MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC
